Frequently Asked Questions

What sizes does HydroFlow come in?

HydroFlow bottles are available in two sizes: 24 oz (Standard) and 40 oz (Pro). The 24 oz is perfect for daily commutes and workouts, while the 40 oz is ideal for all-day hydration and outdoor adventures.

How long does the insulation actually last?

Our double-wall insulation technology keeps cold drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot drinks hot for up to 12 hours. The insulation performance remains consistent for years with proper care.

Is it really leak-proof?

Yes! Our leak-proof screw-top lid with silicone gasket has been tested to withstand extreme conditions. However, we recommend checking the lid is properly sealed before placing in bags.

Can I put it in the dishwasher?

We recommend hand washing your HydroFlow bottle to maintain the integrity of the insulation and lid. Wash with warm soapy water and air dry completely before refilling.

What's included with my purchase?

Every HydroFlow bottle comes with the bottle itself, a premium screw-top lid, and our comprehensive care guide. The Pro model also includes a free stainless steel carry handle.

Do you offer a warranty?

Absolutely! Every HydroFlow bottle includes a lifetime warranty covering manufacturing defects. We stand behind our products because we know they're built to last.

Can I return my bottle if I'm not satisfied?

Yes. We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all purchases. If you're not completely satisfied, simply contact our customer service team for a full refund, no questions asked.

How do I clean the bottle properly?

Hand wash with warm soapy water immediately after use. For stubborn stains, soak in warm water with a bit of baking soda. Rinse thoroughly and air dry. Never use abrasive scrubbers on the exterior finish.
